about_the_game: Warbox lets players simulate realistic firefights with intelligent AI. Players are not only able to watch the battles happen but can take control of any soldier they like. A built-in faction and soldier customization system lets players design their own factions and soldiers in those factions. Players can define the roles for each soldier like squad leaders, medics, anti-tank, and more.
